answer: Proof of space-time mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to commit dedicated storage to cryptographic plots and answer periodic challenges. An adversary cannot maintain a synthetic island of virtual identities without provisioning real disk capacity, incurring linear hardware costs. Valid commitments anchor to an ivory ledger, suppressing the violet noise of zero-cost identity floods. However, this framework favors industrial storage syndicates and penalizes lightweight agents.
